name: Just
overview: Scripture reveals that God is perfectly just, exemplified by His flawless works and righteous judgment, as seen in Deuteronomy 32:4 and Isaiah 5:16. Believers are called to emulate this justice by acting rightly towards others, including relieving the oppressed and defending the vulnerable, as instructed in Isaiah 1:17 and Micah 6:8. The Christian life, empowered by faith in Christ who lives within us (Galatians 2:20), is marked by walking humbly and loving mercy while trusting that God works all things for good (Romans 8:28). This foundation encourages coming just as you are, relying on Christ’s righteousness rather than our own merit.
